summary: Sagimet Biosciences filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten follow-on offering of 8,750,010 Series A common shares plus pre-funded warrants for 2,750,010 shares, priced at $10.00 per share and $9.9999 per pre-funded warrant, raising about $115.0 million gross and $108.1 million net. Underwriters Leerink, TD Cowen, Guggenheim and Oppenheimer lead; closing expected October 1, 2026. The warrants are immediately exercisable at $0.0001, unlisted and illiquid. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch deal pricing versus the $9.33 reference close and dilution.
